claims.claim: No dead pixel, no line on the screen
claims.evidence: Witness notes the TV is on and shows the webOS home screen/ocean scene, but does not report a dead-pixel/line test.
Witness photos do not show the remote.
No service history, warranty card, or internal inspection is shown.

risks.risk: Screen defects (dead pixels, lines, burn-in) may not be visible in the limited scenes captured.
risks.proof: A short video/clip showing a full-screen solid color test (red/green/blue/white/black) plus a grid/line pattern, filmed close to the screen at multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: screen may have hidden defects; treat as not fully tested for panel issues.

risks.risk: Resolution/spec (4K vs lower) and exact model may be different from the seller’s stated model.
risks.proof: Photo of the TV’s Settings → About/Device Information page showing model number and resolution, or a clear label on the back/side.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: unknown exact model/spec; value at the lowest confirmed smart-TV tier from the photos.

risks.risk: Ports/inputs may be faulty (HDMI/USB/antenna), affecting usability.
risks.proof: A clip demonstrating at least one HDMI input working (e.g., connect a phone/laptop and show the input switching) and one USB playback.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: assume inputs may be unreliable; discount accordingly until tested.

risks.risk: Audio/speaker issues may exist even if the picture is fine.
risks.proof: A short clip playing a video with visible subtitles and audible dialogue (showing volume control and clear sound).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: audio not guaranteed; discount until sound is confirmed.

risks.risk: Remote may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: Photo of the remote and a clip showing basic button presses (power/menu/volume) controlling the TV.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: remote not included or not working.

risks.risk: Wall-mount/stand completeness and mounting hardware may be missing, affecting installation.
risks.proof: Photos of the back/underside showing stand type and included wall-mount brackets/bolts (if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: installation hardware not included.

risks.risk: Power supply/backlight problems may be intermittent and not show in a single on-screen moment.
risks.proof: A 10–15 minute continuous power-on video showing stable brightness (no flicker/dimming) and no shutdowns.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: assume possible intermittent power/backlight faults.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the TV’s Settings → About/Device Information showing exact model number and resolution (UHD/4K).
Send a close-up photo of the back/side label with model and serial number.
Provide a short video of full-screen color/dead-pixel and line/grid tests (red/green/blue/white/black + grid).
Show a clip switching inputs and confirming at least one HDMI and one USB port works.
Show a clip proving audio works (dialogue/video) and that volume controls respond.
Photo of the remote plus a short clip demonstrating it controls the TV.
Photos of included accessories: stand/wall-mount hardware and any cables.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a large LG smart TV with webOS powered on, but key pricing drivers (exact size/model, 4K confirmation, and panel/port/remote condition) are not verifiable from the provided report. Missing these means any worst-case price would be unreliable without the specific proof shots.
